ev.q: In 2022, among adults aged ≥18 years, 16.2% walked for transportation in the past 7 days
Urban residents were more likely than rural residents to walk for transportation and leisure.
58.7% walked for leisure in the past 7 days
16.2% walked for transportation in the past 7 days, and 58.7% walked for leisure
Urban residents were more likely than rural residents to walk for transportation and leisure.
Estimates are based on household interviews of a sample of the civilian, noninstitutionalized U.S. population.
Source: National Center for Health Statistics, National Health Interview Survey, 2022.

methods_quotes.q: With 95% CIs indicated by error bars.
